intro.narration: High noon at the corner. Mang Bebot's sari-sari store is open, and so is his ledger.

intro.speaker: mang_bebot
intro.text: Ah, so you're the one who beat Lolo Carding. Have a seat. Softdrink? ...that one isn't free, ha.

intro.speaker: ate_marites
intro.text: Uy Bebot, this kid is the talk of the town! Beat Lolo, then beat me too, Marites herself!

intro.speaker: mang_bebot
intro.text: I know. It's all written here. Including your two unpaid Sprites, Marites.

intro.speaker: ate_marites
intro.text: HA?! We're friends, right?! ...anyway, do you know Kuya Rico?

intro.speaker: ate_marites
intro.text: Three months with no load, right there in Bebot's ledger, but still playing nonstop. Just saying.

intro.speaker: mang_bebot
intro.text: Marites is right. But right now, it's your turn. Put down that three of clubs.

intro.speaker: mang_bebot
intro.text: Quiet. Good. The loud ones are easy to read. Same as the ones who want to borrow.

intro.narration: Mang Bebot slowly opened the worn notebook to a fresh page and clicked his pen.

intro.speaker: mang_bebot
intro.text: Remember this: at my table, everything has a price. Lose and I write it down. Win, and I hand you an even bigger challenge.

win.narration: Your hand is empty. Bebot glanced at the ledger, then back at you.

win.speaker: mang_bebot
win.text: Wait. You're out of cards? Let me count. Sometimes my records are off... no, that's right.

win.speaker: ate_marites
win.text: BEBOT LOST! Let me check the ledger. 'Bebot loses,' and look, it even has a date!

win.speaker: mang_bebot
win.text: Hmp. Well played. Don't celebrate too hard, though.

win.speaker: mang_bebot
win.text: Next time, the stakes double. You owe me a rematch, and you will pay up.

win.speaker: mang_bebot
win.text: Go on, take the softdrink home. On the house, just this once.

lose.narration: Time is up. Bebot closed the notebook.

lose.speaker: mang_bebot
lose.text: You're in the ledger now. One loss, one unpaid softdrink.

lose.speaker: ate_marites
lose.text: Ay nako, go line up with Kuya Rico in the debtors' queue. Hehe.

lose.speaker: mang_bebot
lose.text: Come back. The store is open, and so is the ledger.

lines.speaker: mang_bebot
lines.text: Wait, only three left? Hold on, let me check the ledger if this is even allowed...

lines.speaker: mang_bebot
lines.text: Not allowed. Nobody wins on credit at my store!

lines.speaker: ate_marites
lines.text: Cleared a second time! Like Bebot's stock on payday, gone in a flash!
